scope: only/sole/last/full-service grocery store loss, closure, fire, or disaster
canceled/suspended emergency food distributions due to storm, flood, fire, outage, or facility damage
abrupt pantry/food-bank closure or major access reduction
official SNAP/WIC/food-assistance interruption with immediate access consequences
coverage_notes.notes: Bounded supplementary recall watch only; production collection remains authoritative. No new qualifying U.S. food-access disruption was found after the prior completed hourly check. Fresh search results were non-qualifying, outside the observation window, or showed services/distributions continuing. Donation drives, resource guides, recipes, opinion, routine promotion, generic inflation stories, and duplicates were excluded.
